# PixelForge

> 2D game editor and engine for the web (Vite, vanilla JS, Phaser 3, Blueprint node-graph scripts). A game is one JSON file in games/<id>.pixelforge.json, editable by AI through an MCP server, a CLI, or directly.

Start with AGENTS.md. Then call the MCP tool `pixelforge_guide`, or read the API reference.

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): workflow, text-sprite format, golden rules, recipes (platformer, top-down, projectile, pickup, patrol), how to write a Blueprint graph as JSON
- [docs/SCRIPT_API.md](docs/SCRIPT_API.md): scripting API (self, game, input, on)
- [docs/BLUEPRINTS.md](docs/BLUEPRINTS.md): Blueprint graph format (nodes, pins, links), node catalogue contract, compilation to JavaScript
- [docs/PROJECT_SCHEMA.json](docs/PROJECT_SCHEMA.json): JSON Schema of the project file
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): architecture, storage, library, AI integration

## Tools
- [mcp/server.js](mcp/server.js): MCP server (stdio), configured in .mcp.json (`npm run mcp`)
- [mcp/cli.js](mcp/cli.js): `npm run pf -- list | show | validate | compile | render | export <game> [map]` and `npm run pf -- nodes [word]` (Blueprint node catalogue)
- [mcp/lib/](mcp/lib/): Node library (PNG codec, text sprites, validation, ASCII map rendering, HTML export)

## Optional
- [src/core/project.js](src/core/project.js): project defaults and normalization (migrates old Blockly scripts to graphs)
- [src/graph/](src/graph/): Blueprint core: node catalogue (nodes.js), graph -> JavaScript compiler (compile.js)
- [src/runtime/engine.js](src/runtime/engine.js): the game engine
- [src/core/sample.js](src/core/sample.js): complete sample project
